content.text:
Yes, this is really common at 20 months. Sudden night wakings often show up with big developmental leaps, teething, or a change in routine. They usually pass.

Tonight, keep the 2am visit boring. Go in, keep the lights off and your voice low, and give a quick pat or a few words. Then leave while they're still a little awake, and skip the pickup or the snack. A predictable response helps them settle back to sleep on their own.

If they seem sick or in pain, call 811 any time, or 911 in an emergency.
